Burrow Huanglongbing (HLB; Citrus Greening) and Nutrient Deficiency Identification Download Related Pages Menu Close Huanglongbing (HLB) is a bacterial disease that is spread by an insect, the Asian citrus psyllid. This fact sheet, which is best viewed as a PDF ( https://edis.ifas.ufl.edu/pdffiles/PP/PP32800.pdf ), explains how to tell the difference between HLB symptoms and symptoms from nutrient deficiencies.
